text: Removal is complete in ScalaFIM commit c7f213a and standalone CI passed at a336783. Maven release tagging is intentionally withheld: GitHub reports zero Actions secrets for canardlapin/bids4s, while release.yml requires PGP_PASSPHRASE, PGP_SECRET, SONATYPE_USERNAME, and SONATYPE_PASSWORD. A v0.1.0 tag would deterministically fail publication until those credentials and the io.github.canardlapin namespace are configured.
